WITH RECURSIVE arrivals(platform_id, arrival_min, close_min) AS (
  SELECT platform_id, open_min, close_min FROM platform_window WHERE open_min < close_min
  UNION ALL
  SELECT platform_id, arrival_min + 1, close_min FROM arrivals WHERE arrival_min + 1 < close_min
), waits AS (
  SELECT a.platform_id, (SELECT MIN(t.depart_min) FROM train_call AS t WHERE t.platform_id = a.platform_id AND t.depart_min >= a.arrival_min) - a.arrival_min AS wait_min
  FROM arrivals AS a
), totals AS (
  SELECT platform_id, COUNT(*) AS rider_count, SUM(wait_min) AS wait_minutes FROM waits GROUP BY platform_id
)
SELECT p.platform_id, COALESCE(t.rider_count, 0) AS rider_count, COALESCE(t.wait_minutes, 0) AS wait_minutes
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT platform_id FROM platform_window) AS p LEFT JOIN totals AS t USING (platform_id)
ORDER BY p.platform_id

       (e.fee_cents - COALESCE(e.rebate_cents, 0)) + (w.fee_cents - COALESCE(w.rebate_cents, 0)) AS net_cents,
       e.advance_cents + w.advance_cents AS advance_cents

WITH assignments AS (
  SELECT r.pod_id AS receiver, p.pod_id, p.entrants, p.fixed_desks + (p.pod_id = r.pod_id) AS desk_count
  FROM checkin_pod AS r CROSS JOIN checkin_pod AS p WHERE r.spare_socket = 1
), times AS (
  SELECT receiver, pod_id, desk_count, entrants / desk_count + (entrants % desk_count <> 0) AS clear_min FROM assignments
), winner AS (
  SELECT receiver FROM times GROUP BY receiver
  ORDER BY MAX(clear_min), SUM(clear_min), receiver COLLATE BINARY LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'pod_id,desk_count,clear_min' || char(10) || group_concat(csv_line, '') AS csv_body
FROM (
  SELECT pod_id || ',' || desk_count || ',' || clear_min || char(10) AS csv_line
  FROM times JOIN winner USING (receiver) ORDER BY pod_id COLLATE BINARY
)

WITH images AS (
  SELECT lot_code, feed_pos, day_no, crate_count * deposit_cents AS liability FROM crate_image
), movements AS (
  SELECT day_no, liability - LAG(liability, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY lot_code ORDER BY feed_pos) AS change_cents FROM images
)
SELECT day_no, SUM(change_cents) AS liability_change_cents
FROM movements WHERE day_no BETWEEN 2 AND 4
GROUP BY day_no ORDER BY day_no
